text: APPROVE. `StepInQuote` and `IsShebang` reproduce the removed branches exactly (backslash skips the next char, the closing quote resets to `'\0'`, and `#!` returns -1), so behaviour is unchanged. Moving two nested branches and a compound condition out of `CommentStart` should bring its complexity under 15, and `ref i` on a `for` variable and the span parameter both compile. I haven't run the build or the complexity analyzer to confirm.
